facts.title: React Bits — Free Animated React Components
facts.description: Free, open source React components for animated text, backgrounds, interactive cards and micro interactions. Explore live demos and copy the source.

research.name: React Bits
research.note: Large set of animated React text effects, backgrounds and cursors with live customizers, plus a paid Pro tier.

effects: Split Flap Text, a mechanical departure board that clacks through phrases

unverified: The component source is in the public repository github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits; research that repository instead of this site. GitHub reports its license as NOASSERTION.
Electric Border, Laser Flow and Ghost Cursor were seen only as sidebar names; their WebGL previews did not render in headless Chrome.
